subtitleNullable: E-Waste Battery Detection Dataset for Computer Vision Applications
descriptionNullable:
This dataset contains annotated images of Android mobile phone batteries collected for object detection and computer vision research. The primary objective of the dataset is to support the development of AI and robotic vision systems capable of identifying and localizing mobile phone batteries during the disassembly, extraction, recycling, and automation of electronic waste (e-waste).

The dataset was manually annotated using CVAT.ai with bounding box annotations to identify the location of batteries within each image accurately. The annotations are suitable for training object detection models such as YOLO, Faster R-CNN, SSD, and other deep learning-based detection systems.

Dataset Details

| Attribute          | Description                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Dataset Type       | Object Detection                                      |
| Annotation Type    | Bounding Box                                          |
| Annotation Tool    | [CVAT.ai](https://www.cvat.ai?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| Total Images       | 124                                                   |
| Object Class       | Battery                                               |
| Image Category     | Android Mobile Phone Internal Components              |
| Intended Use       | Battery detection and localization                    |
| Annotation Quality | Manually annotated                                    |
| Dataset Format     | YOLO-compatible annotation format                     |
| Data Split         | Uploaded as 3 separate sets/jobs                      |
